name: Actions
description: Compose response actions, nested menus, copy, and controlled feedback.
notes: Defaults: items=[], variant="borderless".
Item callbacks run before the group onClick callback.

name: ActionsCopy
description: Named export of the asynchronous copy action.
notes: Same component as Actions.Copy.
Without onCopy, uses the browser clipboard; rejected copies show failure.
Empty text and pending copy disable the button.

name: ActionsFeedback
description: Named export of controlled like/dislike feedback.
notes: Same component as Actions.Feedback.
Required value is default, like, or dislike; selecting the active choice resets it to default.
The caller persists feedback.

name: Actions.Copy
description: Copy text with caller-supplied or browser clipboard behavior.
notes: Defaults: disabled=false, variant="borderless".
onCopy must reject on failure rather than reporting a false success.

name: Actions.Feedback
description: Render mutually exclusive controlled positive and negative feedback.
notes: Defaults: disabled=false, variant="borderless".
No backend write is performed by the component.

name: AttachmentFileCard
description: Named export of the single-attachment status and removal card.
notes: Same component as Attachments.FileCard.
Uploading or disabled cards hide removal; missing percent uses indeterminate progress.

name: Attachments
description: Select, drag, and display input files while the caller owns upload state.
notes: Defaults: items=[], multiple=true, disabled=false, overflow="wrap".
onPick replaces the native picker; onSelectFiles is still required for drag/drop.
maxCount limits native selection/drop; enforce the same limit for pasted files.
Uploading does not mount a file into a session.

name: Attachments.FileCard
description: Display one AttachmentItem without a file picker.
notes: disabled defaults to false.
onRemove only notifies the caller; it does not delete a remote file.

name: Layout
description: Compose a desktop sidebar, mobile drawer, page header, and bounded content area without owning application state.
notes: sidebar accepts content or a render callback receiving closeSidebar and closeButton; compose the rail frame (width, border, mobile hiding) yourself.
header receives the mobile menu toggle; without header, mobileTitle labels the mobile fallback header.
sidebarLabel defaults to the built-in navigation label; fitViewport defaults to true and can be disabled by a host that owns viewport sizing.
Keep route, identity, session, and pending-confirmation state in the caller; pass controlled dialogs through the dialogs slot.
Select the workspace theme explicitly and provide a bounded parent height.

name: Chat
description: Compose a message list with inline child Agent cards, a default Sender, and main Agent approvals.
notes: Defaults: variant=default, turnRunning=false, canSend=true. Select workspace explicitly for the employee layout.
Pass useChat().multiAgent for child discovery, read-only history, pagination, retry, and preserved main drafts.
Children expand within the main message stream; Chat does not switch Agent tabs.
Pass skills to enable inline chips; adapt onSend(text, skills) to chat.send(text, { skills }).
Child status never completes the main turn; approvals belong to the main Agent and must be null when absent.
The default draft clears only after a successful send and only if unchanged.
A custom sender slot owns its send, stop, loading, and submit-disabled wiring.
scrollKey changes reset list following without remounting the input.
composerDisabled disables the default input while preserving stop; canSend only gates submission.

name: AgentHeader
description: Display the selected agent and an application-owned action area.
notes: actions replaces the default new-session button; actions=null hides the area.
Session creation is a caller responsibility.
A non-empty agents list with onPickAgent enables a controlled title selector.
Icons accept image URLs, relative paths, and text such as emoji.

name: isIconImageSource
description: Use the shared Agent icon rule when rendering an application-owned icon layout.
notes: Returns true only for values starting with http:, https:, data:, /, or ./.
Missing values and text such as emoji return false; the caller renders the text or a fallback.
This is a pure helper, not a React component; it does not fetch or validate image availability.

name: ConfirmDialog
description: Display an explicit confirmation or cancellation choice.
notes: danger defaults to true; the caller conditionally mounts the dialog.
Radix AlertDialog manages focus containment and restoration; busy disables confirmation, cancellation, and Escape.
The caller owns the actual plan, confirmation token, pending state, and close-on-success behavior.

name: EmptyState
description: Display a titled empty-state message with an optional hint.

name: ErrorState
description: Display an accessible error message and optional retry action.
notes: Retry is shown only when onRetry is supplied; the caller defines its effect.

name: SessionSidebar
description: Render the session directory area: agent groups with lazy per-group pagination, a recent section, search filtering, and caller-owned selection and row actions.
notes: Renders only the directory; the rail frame, brand header, new-chat entry, navigation, and account areas belong to the caller.
Groups and recent carry their own page state; onLoad fires when a group expands, and onRetry/onLoadMore back the retry card and load-more affordances.

onSelect reports the clicked session summary and section, so navigation can read agent_slug without re-lookup; activeSection attributes the active highlight to one section, and activeGroupId auto-expands the open session's group (open-only, never auto-closes).
Inline rename is controlled per section via editing {id, section}; the menu render prop receives (session, section) so rename stays scoped to the clicked section.
Clean stale index status out of sessions before passing them in; the component renders the data it receives.
Archive/delete callbacks do not bypass application confirmation.

name: StatusIndicator
description: Display transport connection and execution phase independently.
notes: Required compatibility props are connected and turnRunning.
New integrations should also pass phase, connection, and streamError as error.

name: SubAgentPanel
description: Aside resources section listing the session's sub-agents deduped by display name; expanding a name reveals its dispatches and a task row opens a dialog with that dispatch's event timeline.
notes: Pass the multiAgent snapshot from useChat; the section renders nothing until sub-agent threads exist.
The dialog loads the sub-thread's own event history, so it does not depend on main-stream message pagination.

name: ThreadPanel
description: Render projected child-thread messages with shared copy and download callbacks.
notes: An empty threads record renders nothing.
This is a compatibility display for already projected messages; new conversation pages should pass multiAgent to Chat.
ThreadPanel does not discover threads, load history, or paginate. Child-thread state is not the main turn's completion signal.

name: CodeHighlighter
description: Display syntax-highlighted code with optional line numbers and copying.
notes: Defaults: copyable=true, showLineNumbers=false; missing language uses text.
Unsupported languages and inputs over 50,000 characters retain full plain text.
header=false hides the header and its copy action.

name: FileCard
description: Display file identity, thumbnail, metadata, and injected open/download actions.
notes: Defaults: loading=false, disabled=false.
onClick is the primary action when present; otherwise onDownload is primary.
The caller supplies src and performs downloads.

name: Markdown
description: Render sanitized GFM text, code blocks, and complete Mermaid fences.
notes: children must be a string.
Keep rehype-sanitize when customizing untrusted message content.
Incomplete Mermaid fences remain source during streaming.

name: Mermaid
description: Display a Mermaid diagram or source with safe streaming fallback.
notes: Defaults: defaultRenderType="image", copyable=true, streaming=false.
Streaming, invalid, or resource-loading syntax falls back to source.
SVG is rendered as an image under strict Mermaid security.

name: ArtifactCard
description: Adapt output artifact metadata to FileCard and injected preview and download actions.
notes: Output artifacts are distinct from input attachments.
The caller provides filename and optional contentType, onOpen, and onDownload.

name: Message
description: Render one projected ChatMessage with ordered rich parts and execution status.
notes: Consumes core ChatMessage; does not parse provider SSE.
Only adjacent text/reasoning parts are combined, preserving tool and artifact order.
Copy is exposed for completed assistant messages with text.

name: MessageList
description: Render a scrollable message sequence with empty-state and follow controls.
notes: autoScroll defaults to true; the parent needs a bounded height.
Reading older messages pauses following; returning to the bottom restores it.
scrollKey changes or empty messages reset following; autoScroll=false still prevents scrolling.

name: MessageAnchorRail
description: Render the right-edge conversation anchor rail: evenly spaced ticks per user turn, hover tooltip with turn title and reply summary, active turn highlighted.
notes: Renders nothing with fewer than two turns; hidden below the md breakpoint.
MessageList.anchorRail derives turns, syncs the active tick on scroll, and jumps by scrolling only its own container.

name: MessageListSkeleton
description: Render the session-loading skeleton: placeholder blocks mirroring the message layout (user bubbles right, assistant cards left) with a sweeping shimmer.
notes: role=status with an aria-label keeps the loading state legible to assistive tech; the skeleton has no visible text.
Colors and sweep timing come from the --kit-skeleton-* tokens and --kit-animate-skeleton in theme.css; reduced motion degrades to static blocks.

name: ReasoningBlock
description: Display collapsible reasoning text and its lifecycle state.
notes: Reasoning starts collapsed, including while streaming; status changes and text updates preserve manual disclosure choices.
Use the reasoning part's own status, not the overall message status. Missing status does not imply completion.
contentMaxHeight replaces the default max-h-80 class for the expanded content area.

name: ToolCallCard
description: Display a projected tool call, structured parameters, output, and status.
notes: part must be the tool variant of MessagePart.
The component neither executes tools nor requests approval.

name: Prompts
description: Offer starter questions or grouped shortcuts without sending automatically.
notes: Defaults: items=[], vertical=false, wrap=false, fadeIn=false, fadeInLeft=false.
Empty items render nothing; grouped parent cards are not selectable.
The caller chooses draft insertion or submission.

name: Sender
description: Compose text, submit, stop, and integrate caller-owned attachments or suggestions.
notes: Defaults: defaultValue="", submitType="enter", loading=false, submitDisabled=false, disabled=false, readOnly=false.
Default autoSize is one to six rows.
variant=workspace places editing above a toolbar, with prefix on the left and send/stop on the right; the default variant keeps the inline layout.
onSubmit does not clear text; submitDisabled preserves editing.
skills only projects known /name markers as atomic chips; the slash picker is composed with Suggestion.
File upload and session mounting belong to the caller.

name: SenderHeader
description: Named export of the optional Sender header panel.
notes: Same component as Sender.Header; defaults: open=false, closable=true.

name: Sender.Header
description: Show a controlled expandable header above the text input.
notes: Defaults: open=false, closable=true.
Closing the panel does not remove attachments or clear input.

name: SessionList
description: Render controlled session selection with status marks and a business-owned row menu slot.
notes: sessions, activeId, and onSelect are required.

menu is a render prop: called per row as menu(session) and the returned element closes over that session; the trigger, menu surface, and items are rendered by the caller, whose onClick handlers read that session directly.

Inline rename is controlled: set editingId to enter edit mode; onEdited reports the trimmed title truncated to 120 chars (empty or unchanged skips), onEditEnd fires on commit or Escape and the caller clears editingId.
The component owns the action slot visibility (hover reveal, hidden while editing); callers own containers, destructive-action confirmation, and backend requests.

name: Tooltip
description: Show a hover/focus tooltip bubble above, below, or beside a trigger.
notes: Trigger renders inline; the caller className carries truncation and layout classes.
overflowOnly shows the bubble only when the trigger content is actually clipped.
The bubble is hoverable, hides on outside scroll and resize, scrolls internally past a max height, and never renders during SSR.

name: Menu
description: Open a keyboard-accessible command menu anchored to a trigger.
notes: Thin wrapper over the Radix DropdownMenu root; pass open/onOpenChange for controlled usage.

name: MenuTrigger
description: Mark the element that toggles the attached menu.
notes: Use asChild to keep your own button styling; Radix adds aria-haspopup and aria-expanded.

name: MenuContent
description: Render the themed floating menu surface (border, shadow, entrance motion) in a portal.
notes: Defaults: align=start, sideOffset=6; Radix flips the side when viewport space runs out.

name: MenuItem
description: Render one selectable menu row with shared hover and keyboard highlight.
notes: Put icons and labels directly in children; onSelect fires on click and Enter.

name: Suggestion
description: Compose a keyboard-accessible command menu with a controlled text input.
notes: Defaults: items=[], block=false; with trigger omitted the popup stays closed until onTrigger.
Automatic mode takes controlled value/caret plus trigger; Escape dismisses the current query until it changes.
Forward both onKeyDown and inputProps to Sender so Enter/Tab selects without sending.
The caller defines filter and insertion behavior through onSelect(value, item, context).

name: ToolApprovalCard
description: Review actual tool parameters and explicitly approve or deny one pending call.
notes: Only actionable pending requests permit decisions.
Allow and deny submit directly without a confirmation dialog; the server re-validates against Provider state.
Uncertain outcomes require refresh; submitted does not mean execution completed.
The caller supplies submitApproval, refreshApprovals, and optionally stop.

name: ToolApprovalGroup
description: Page horizontally through multiple pending tool approvals, one card at a time.
notes: Renders only the current approval with a 1/N pager; decided items auto-advance to the next pending request.
Manual pager selection is preserved while the item stays in the list.
Renders nothing when approvals is empty; accepts the same callbacks as ToolApprovalCard.

name: PlazaCard
description: Display one discovery entry and notify the caller when its agent is opened.
notes: onOpen receives the entry slug; navigation and Session selection belong to the caller.

name: CategoryTabs
description: Select a controlled discovery category or the featured tab.
notes: Prepends featured to the supplied categories.
Category counts are accepted but not displayed.

name: MeterBar
description: Render quota usage as a bounded fill or an unlimited track.
notes: Defaults: unlimited=false, className="".
Visual fill is clamped to zero through 100 percent; nonpositive max has no fill.

name: ActivityHeatmap
description: Render caller-supplied daily activity with relative intensity.
notes: Preserves input order; day strings must be unique.
Does not fetch, sort, or fill missing dates.

name: SkillGlyph
description: Render the shared book glyph used by skill chips and suggestion items.
notes: Decorative SVG with aria-hidden=true; size and color come from className.
Use it in Suggestion item icons so custom skill pickers match Sender chips.
